nextStoryContext: Fixed the CONTEXT.md doc-sync gap recorded in this story's prd.json notes: .cam-dispatch-failed.json (CAM-433) had no glossary entry, unlike its three most-recently-added durable-marker siblings (sidecar-stalled marker, post-merge-stalled, plan preflight's embedded plan-preflight-failed mention). Added three glossary entries at the end of CONTEXT.md, in the same style as the sibling marker entries: 'dispatch-failed marker' (the .cam-dispatch-failed.json file itself: contents, when it's written, when it's cleared -- convergence-only, never boot-read, distinct from the boot-surfaced marker family), 'verified dispatch' (the runVerifiedDispatch shared primitive: relabel + respawn-pane + identity check + pipe), and 'pane_pid identity verification' (the before/after #{pane_pid} read that proves a respawn-pane exit 0 actually replaced the process). Sourced definitions from src/supervisor/dispatch-failed-marker.ts, src/supervisor/verified-dispatch.ts, and src/supervisor/worker-dispatch.ts to keep the glossary accurate to the real fields/behavior (glossary-only, no implementation detail per the Domain Model Convention). No code changed; doc-only diff. Full gates re-run clean: typecheck 0 errors, bun test 5665 pass / 0 fail, bun run check:all all-green (file-size, debt-markers, version-skips, coverage, dead-code, dup, ci-parity, agents-md, test-sleeps, embed-vendor up to date, lint).
